name: Caiaphas
bio: Caiaphas, the high priest, hosted the chief priests and elders at his palace as they plotted to arrest and kill Jesus by stealth, avoiding the feast days to prevent an uproar among the people (Matthew 26:3-5). His role presiding over Jesus's trial is told in detail in the chapters ahead. Jesus was brought to Caiaphas's house, where the council sought false testimony against him. When Jesus admitted under direct questioning that he was the Christ, Caiaphas tore his robes, declared it blasphemy, and led the council in condemning him to death (Matthew 26:57-68).
